what_it_does: This is a reproducibility report verifying an SC25 conference paper about the Sparsified Preconditioned Conjugate Gradient Solver on GPUs. The original paper addresses the problem of solving large sparse systems of linear equations efficiently on GPUs. The solver uses sparsification—dropping small values to reduce computation—and preconditioning—mathematical techniques to accelerate convergence. This report independently evaluates whether the paper's published results can be reproduced using the authors' provided code and methodology.
